description: This line plot illustrates the progression of next-token prediction accuracy over training steps for two distinct models, as presented in the paper “RedWhale: An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining.” The x-axis, labeled “Step,” is linear and spans from 0 to 50,000, with major tick marks at intervals of 10,000. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (Next Token Prediction),” is also linear, ranging from 0.10 to 0.40, with tick marks at 0.05 intervals. Two primary lines are plotted: a solid blue line with dark blue circular markers and a solid teal line with teal circular markers. The blue line begins at approximately (10,000, 0.25), rises sharply to (20,000, 0.40), and then continues to climb gradually, reaching approximately (50,000, 0.48). The teal line starts at (10,000, 0.10), increases steeply to (20,000, 0.32), and then continues its ascent more gradually, reaching approximately (50,000, 0.44). In the upper right corner, a partially visible dark gray line with light teal circular markers, labeled “EX2,” appears to follow a similar upward trend, beginning near (40,000, 0.40) and rising to approximately (50,000, 0.46). All lines show a consistent positive trend, indicating improving accuracy with increasing training steps.
